body:
When it comes to planning the nursery, EVERY parent deserves furniture options that offer both quality AND style.

dadada Baby is on a mission to make sure no parent ever has to choose between furniture that lasts and furniture they love again. That’s why they’re continuing to expand their collection of modern, quality-built cribs, dressers, and toddler products to give parents more options that support their unique vision for baby’s nursery. Every dadada Baby piece is manufactured and finished to the highest safety standards and built to stay with families for generations. No more particle board pieces destined for the landfill - these are true furniture staples that parents will be proud to show off, and eventually, pass down to their grandchildren.

Joining the dadada Baby collections this fall are two fashion-forward finishes for the timeless Austin 5-Drawer Dresser. The white and red oak combination adds a perfect glow of natural warmth to any room, while white and black create high contrast style impact.

The Gramercy Dresser is the new ideal partner for the Soho 3-in-1 Crib. Available in three shades (denim, meringue, and sage), Gramercy is built to the standard parents expect from dadada Baby, with clean modern lines, and anti-topple sturdy construction.

Competing with Gramercy for the heart of the Soho 3-in-1 Crib is the new Soho Dresser. A true stunner in black or white with natural accents, the Soho Dresser looks just as fresh in a home office, den, or dining room as it does in a modern nursery.

Last but not least in the list of can’t-miss new products for fall is the Cambridge 3-in-1 Convertible Crib. A modern update to a classic crib design, the Cambridge is a true 3-in-1 and includes the toddler conversion kit with purchase so parents have everything they need from the beginning.
New parents deserve modern options they can trust to keep baby safe, secure, and thriving. dadada Baby continues to deliver more of those options, helping make impeccable style accessible to parents in big and small spaces, so every baby can have a truly beautiful beginning.
About dadada Baby:

dadada Baby is a modern nursery furniture company founded by the Segal Group, that recognized the need for well-designed, high-quality, ethically constructed furniture to suit sustainably minded parents. Family-owned with knowledge and industry experience dating back to 1932, dadada Baby draws its inspiration from modern urban life with roots firmly planted in trusted Italian manufacturing. Each piece is meant to last for generations, so parents never have to choose between style or sustainability. In a culture becoming increasingly aware of the consequences of disposable, poorly constructed products, dadada Baby pieces provide an opportunity for families to make an eco-minded investment without compromising on style.

Products are available to order online at a variety of independent retail establishments or visit dadadababy.com to find a local retailer near you.
